description_en: Sets the asset scope for a specified control policy
description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的资产生效范围
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-asset-scope --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --scope-type All --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyAssetScope

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy to modify.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的控制策略的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The asset scope for the control policy. Valid values:
All: applies to all assets.
Host: applies to selected hosts.
Database: applies to selected databases.
HostGroup: applies to selected asset groups
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产范围。取值：
All：针对所有资产生效
Host：针对已选择的主机生效
Database：针对已选择的数据库生效
HostGroup：针对已选择的资产组生效
parameters.name: scope_type

fields.help_en:
The scope of host accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

All: applies to all accounts on the host.
AccountId: applies to specified accounts on the host
fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的主机账户范围。取值：

All：针对主机中的所有账户生效
AccountId：针对主机中指定的账户生效
fields.name: account_scope_type

fields.help_en:
The host accounts to which the control policy applies.

Required when AccountScopeType is set to AccountId
fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的主机账户范围。

当AccountScopeType为 AccountId 时必填
fields.name: host_account_ids

parameters.help_en:
The hosts to which the control policy applies.

Required when ScopeType is set to Host. A maximum of 500 hosts can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的主机范围。

当ScopeType为 Host 时必填。最多500 个
parameters.name: hosts

fields.help_en:
The scope of database accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

All: applies to all accounts in the database.
AccountId: applies to specified accounts in the database
fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的数据库账户范围。取值：

All：针对数据库中的所有账户生效
AccountId：针对数据库中指定的账户生效
fields.name: account_scope_type

fields.help_en:
The database accounts to which the control policy applies.

Required when AccountScopeType is set to AccountId
fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的数据库账户范围。

当AccountScopeType为 AccountId 时必填
fields.name: database_account_ids

parameters.help_en:
The databases to which the control policy applies.

Required when ScopeType is set to Database. A maximum of 500 databases can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的数据库资产范围。

当ScopeType为  Database 时必填。最多500 个
parameters.name: databases

fields.help_en:
The asset accounts to which the control policy applies.

Required when AccountScopeType is set to AccountNames
fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产账户范围。

当AccountScopeType为 AccountNames 时必填
fields.name: account_names

fields.help_en:
The scope of asset accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

All: applies to all accounts in the asset group.
AccountName: applies to specified accounts in the asset group
fields.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产账户范围。取值：

All：针对资产组中的所有账户生效
AccountName：针对资产组中指定的账户生效
fields.name: account_scope_type

parameters.help_en:
The asset groups to which the control policy applies.

Required when ScopeType is set to HostGroup. A maximum of 100 asset groups can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的资产组范围。

当ScopeType为  HostGroup 时必填。最多100 个
parameters.name: host_groups

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
